statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120147 (PostgreSQL dblink reentrant disconnect use-after-free executes arbitrary code) in 16.16 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120147/ lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/f0aa151863c614c843aac5730a81642732c3564a on the REL_16_STABLE branch, which changes contrib/dblink/dblink.c (plus the dblink regression tests) so that a connection is marked while a dblink call is reading results from it and every other dblink call on that connection is refused until it is done; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-120147 and is in the REL_16_16 release tag and not in REL_16_15. The dblink extension ships in the postgresql16-contrib package. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, in every published postgresql16 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 16.16-r0 reports PostgreSQL 16.16 and carries the fix, while the earlier builds 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 report 16.13, 16.14 and 16.15 and are affected. As a check, the dblink module, /usr/lib/postgresql16/dblink.so, in the postgresql16-contrib package contains the error messages this fix adds ('connection "%s" is already in use' and "connection is already in use") in 16.16-r0 on both architectures, and the same file in 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 does not. 16.16-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix. Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-120147 under its 16.16-r0 secfixes.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120147 (PostgreSQL dblink reentrant disconnect use-after-free executes arbitrary code) in 18.7 for major version 18: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120147/ lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, and the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/b8fbeeb7600778d05bbbe1e7ee81e4491b2116e6 on the REL_18_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-120147 and Backpatch-through: 14, in the REL_18_7 release tag and not in REL_18_6. It changes contrib/dblink/dblink.c so that dblink refuses to use a connection that another dblink call is already using; its other changes are dblink tests. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes, and it lists CVE-2026-120147 under its 18.7-r0 secfixes. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in the dblink extension module, /usr/lib/postgresql18/dblink.so, which the postgresql18-contrib package ships in every one of those builds on both architectures. We checked every published postgresql18 and postgresql18-contrib package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): the postgres server binary in 18.7-r0 reports PostgreSQL 18.7, while the earlier builds 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0 report 18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4 and 18.6. The error message the fix adds to dblink.so, connection "%s" is already in use, appears in the 18.7-r0 postgresql18-contrib package and in no earlier build, while the existing message could not establish connection appears in every build. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120147, a use after free in the dblink extension when type conversion code re-enters dblink and closes a connection an outer dblink call is reading, in 17.12 (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120147/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-120147, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/). Earlier 17 releases are affected. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0. The dblink extension (dblink.so) ships in the postgresql-17 package of every build in the repository today, on amd64 and arm64.
